# Query settings and index filters as plan pinning

# Query settings and index filters as plan pinning — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Query settings and index filters as plan pinning. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-30 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] Index hints in query settings restrict the planner's available indexes but do not guarantee an index scan; legacy index filters likewise allow a collection scan. Neither mechanism guarantees an exact execution plan. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md
- [statement] Before interpreting an index-hiding trial, inspect restrictions that reference the candidate or exclude alternatives. This is a methodological inference: a legacy filter restricted to the hidden index can produce a collection scan even when another visible index could otherwise support the query. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/core/index-hidden/
- [statement] Tencent recommends restricting only critical queries whose plan drift would cause an incident and reconsidering settings when data distribution changes. MinervaDB similarly presents query settings as a mitigation and recommends removing the setting after a durable indexing correction. (medium confidence) — https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407 · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://minervadb.com/mongodb-performance-troubleshooting/
- [statement] Legacy index filters last only for the server process. Campbell independently reported rejecting filters in a 2017 production incident because they did not survive restarts. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://youdidwhatwithtsql.com/mongodb-occasionally-naughty-query/2284/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB 8.0 introduced setQuerySettings and deprecated index filters; query settings apply to matching query shapes across the cluster and persist across restarts, while legacy index filters are process-local and disappear at shutdown. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md, https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407, https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/reference/glossary.html
- [statement] If the indexes named by a legacy index filter do not exist or are hidden, MongoDB documents a collection scan. A hidden index is unavailable to the planner and cannot be selected with cursor.hint(). (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/core/index-hidden/
- [statement] If matching query settings contain index hints, MongoDB ignores command-level index hints. A client hint alone therefore cannot prove which index candidates the planner received. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md
- [statement] SERVER-60710 reports indexFilterSet remaining false with executionStats verbosity despite an applied filter, tested on 4.4.9 and 5.0.2; the issue lists fix version 6.0.0-rc0. On those historical versions, that flag alone cannot establish that a filter is absent. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-60710
- [statement] MongoDB introduced query settings in 8.0 and deprecated legacy index filters in 8.0. Query settings apply to matching query shapes cluster-wide and persist across restarts. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md
- [statement] MongoDB 8.0 hidden indexes cannot support queries and cannot be selected with cursor.hint(); unhiding a maintained index makes it immediately available again. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/core/index-hidden/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Inspect configured query settings with db.aggregate([{ $querySettings: {} }]); remove obsolete settings with removeQuerySettings. Verify applied settings and the actual winning plan with explain. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407
- [statement] SERVER-33303 reproduces MongoDB 3.6.2 retaining a legacy filter after dropping its target index but temporarily not applying it; creating another index makes the filter apply again and selects COLLSCAN. The issue lists fix version 4.1.5. This is historical evidence, not a claim that current releases retain the bug. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-33303
- [statement] If all indexes specified by a legacy filter are hidden or absent, the optimizer uses a collection scan. A removal rehearsal must therefore inspect filters, not just index usage. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Query settings and index filters as plan pinning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/core/index-hidden/
- [statement] For legacy filters, check explain.indexFilterSet. Their shape includes query, sort, projection and collation; predicate literal values do not distinguish matching shapes. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md
- [statement] Tencent recommends restricting index choices only for critical queries, testing representative parameters, and revisiting restrictions after data-distribution changes. This is operational guidance, not an execution-plan guarantee. (low confidence) — https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407
- [statement] Campbell reported that a frequent outlier literal caused an index choice unsuitable for most queries sharing its shape. This historical incident motivates testing parameter diversity before applying shape-wide restrictions. (low confidence) — https://youdidwhatwithtsql.com/mongodb-occasionally-naughty-query/2284/
